questions.question_text: What does the 'type' property in an ARM template resource definition specify?

options.label: A
options.text: The API version of the resource provider

options.label: C
options.text: The specific resource type within the provider

options.label: D
options.text: The deployment mode for the resource

questions.explanation: The 'type' defines the resource type, e.g., 'Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines', which tells Azure what kind of resource to create.

questions.question_text: You need to change the SKU of a VM from 'Standard_B1s' to 'Standard_D2s_v3'. Which part of the template should you edit?
questions.explanation: The SKU is part of the VM resource definition under 'resources', so you modify the 'sku' property there.

questions.question_text: Which command deploys a Bicep file named 'main.bicep' to a resource group called 'rg1'?

options.label: A
options.text: az deployment group create --template-file main.bicep --resource-group rg1

options.label: C
options.text: az deployment sub create --template main.bicep --resource-group rg1

questions.explanation: The az deployment group create command with --template-file points to the Bicep file and specifies the target resource group.

questions.question_text: How can you convert an existing ARM JSON template into a Bicep file?
questions.explanation: The az bicep convert command reads an ARM JSON template and outputs the equivalent Bicep source file.

questions.question_text: In an ARM template, what is the purpose of a 'defaultValue' for a parameter?

options.label: A
options.text: It defines the data type of the parameter

options.label: B
options.text: It specifies the value used when the parameter is omitted

options.label: C
options.text: It sets the minimum allowed value for the parameter

options.label: D
options.text: It determines the deployment order of resources

questions.explanation: If a parameter is not supplied during deployment, Azure uses the defaultValue to provide a value.

questions.question_text: Which syntax is required to reference a parameter named 'vmName' inside a resource's 'name' property in an ARM template?
questions.explanation: In ARM JSON, parameters are referenced with the brackets syntax: [parameters('vmName')].

questions.question_text: What flag in 'az deployment group create' ensures that the deployment is rolled back if any resource fails?
questions.explanation: The --mode OnError flag tells Azure to roll back the entire deployment when any resource provisioning fails.

questions.question_text: Which command exports the definition of an existing resource into an ARM template?
questions.explanation: az resource export captures the current state of a resource and generates an ARM JSON template representing it.

questions.question_text: When a Bicep file is compiled, which of the following statements is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The compiler validates the template against the Azure resource provider API versions

questions.explanation: During compilation, Bicep validates the template against the latest API versions of the target resource providers.

questions.question_text: Which top-level property defines output values in an ARM template?
questions.explanation: Outputs are declared under the 'outputs' top-level property, allowing you to expose values after deployment.
